goals: Replace the custom arg-parsing layer in `src/cli.ts` with `commander.js`.
Preserve the exact public CLI interface (`bun nvst <command> [subcommand] [options]`) — no breaking changes for end users.
Auto-generate `--help` output at the root level and for each command/subcommand.
Delete the now-redundant helpers (`extractFlagValue`, `parseOptionalIntegerFlag`, `parseProjectContextMode`, `parseForce`, `printUsage`) once replaced.
All existing automated tests continue to pass with no regressions.

userStories.title: Root help auto-generated by commander.js
userStories.description: As a developer running `nvst`, I want `nvst --help` (and `nvst -h`) to print a structured, auto-generated help message so that I always see up-to-date usage without manually maintaining `printUsage()`.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `bun nvst --help` exits with code 0 and prints command/subcommand listing generated by commander.js.
`bun nvst -h` produces identical output.
Output includes all top-level commands: `ideate`, `start`, `define`, `refine`, `approve`, `create`, `audit`, `refactor`, `sync`, `init`, `destroy`, `write-json`, `write-technical-debt`.
Typecheck / lint passes.

userStories.title: Per-command/subcommand `--help`
userStories.description: As a developer, I want `nvst <command> --help` and `nvst <command> <subcommand> --help` to show scoped usage so that I can quickly look up flags for a single command without reading the full help.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `bun nvst create prototype --help` exits 0 and lists `--agent`, `--iterations`, `--retry-on-fail`, `--stop-on-critical`, `--force`.
Every other command and subcommand responds to `--help` with its own scoped output.
Typecheck / lint passes.

userStories.title: All existing commands work identically after migration
userStories.description: As a developer using `nvst`, I want every command to behave exactly as before so that the migration is transparent to end users.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `bun nvst init` runs without error in a fresh directory.
`bun nvst destroy` and `bun nvst destroy --clean` run without error.
`bun nvst start iteration` runs without error.
`bun nvst ideate --agent ide` runs without error.
`bun nvst define requirement --agent ide` runs without error.
`bun nvst refine requirement --agent ide --challenge --force` runs without error.
`bun nvst refine project-context --agent ide` runs without error.
`bun nvst approve requirement`, `approve prototype`, `approve project-context` run without error.
`bun nvst create prototype --agent ide --iterations 2 --retry-on-fail 1 --stop-on-critical` runs without error.
`bun nvst create project-context --agent ide --mode yolo` runs without error.
`bun nvst audit prototype --agent ide` runs without error.
`bun nvst refactor prototype --agent ide` runs without error.
`bun nvst sync skills` runs without error.
`bun nvst write-json` and `bun nvst write-technical-debt` run without error.
Unknown commands/subcommands still print an error and exit with code 1.
`bun nvst -v` / `--version` still prints the version string.
Typecheck / lint passes.

userStories.title: Custom arg-parsing helpers removed
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want the dead-code helpers removed so that the codebase is smaller and does not confuse future maintainers.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `extractFlagValue`, `parseOptionalIntegerFlag`, `parseProjectContextMode`, `parseForce`, and `printUsage` are deleted from `src/cli.ts`.
No other file imports or references these removed functions.
Typecheck / lint passes.

userStories.title: Existing tests pass with no regressions
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the full test suite to pass after the migration so that no existing behaviour is silently broken.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `bun test` completes with 0 failures.
No existing test files are modified to weaken assertions; only test setup that references removed helpers may be updated.
Typecheck / lint passes.

functionalRequirements.description: Add `commander` (latest stable) as a production dependency in `package.json` / `bun.lock`.
`src/cli.ts` must use a single root `Command` instance from commander.js; all commands are registered as subcommands or nested subcommands of it.

The `--agent` option (valid values: `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `cursor`, `copilot`, `ide`) must be registered as a required option on every agent-backed command/subcommand; commander.js validation replaces `parseAgentArg`.
`--force` must be registered as a boolean option on all commands that previously accepted it; commander.js replaces `parseForce`.
`--challenge` must be registered as a boolean option on `refine requirement` and `refine project-context`; commander.js replaces the manual `includes("--challenge")` check.

`--iterations <N>` (integer ≥ 1) and `--retry-on-fail <N>` (integer ≥ 0) must be registered on `create prototype` with custom parsing (`.argParser`) that replicates current validation; commander.js replaces `parseOptionalIntegerFlag`.
`--mode <strict|yolo>` must be registered on `create project-context` with a choices constraint; commander.js replaces `parseProjectContextMode`.
`--clean` must be registered as a boolean option on `destroy`.
`--schema <name>`, `--out <path>`, and `--data <json>` must be registered on `write-json`; stdin fallback behaviour must be preserved in the handler.
`--out <path>` and `--data <json>` must be registered on `write-technical-debt`; stdin fallback behaviour must be preserved.
`--version` / `-v` must continue to print the version string (use commander's `.version()` or a custom action to preserve the `NVST_COMPILED_VERSION` fallback logic).
On unknown commands or missing required arguments, commander.js must print an error and the process must exit with code 1 (no `process.exit()` — set `process.exitCode = 1`).
`GuardrailAbortError` must continue to be caught in the top-level `.catch()` and handled without re-logging.
